content: In recent years, there has been an increasing interest in Machine reading comprehension (MRC), which plays a vital role in the assessment of how well a machine could understand natural language. Several datasets BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 for machine reading comprehension have been released in recent years and have driven the evolution of powerful neural models. However, much of the research up to now has been dominated by answering questions that can be well solved solved using superficial information, yet struggles to do accurate natural language understanding and reasoning. For example, BIBREF3 jia2017Adversarial show that existing machine learning systems for MRC perform poorly under adversarial evaluation. Recent developments in MRC datasets BIBREF4 , BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 have heightened the need for deep understanding.
